column3:
Sliding Car Door, Hands Clear. This CAUTION Room Service Car Door sign from CGAP Safety reads: SLIDING CAR DOOR / KEEP HANDS CLEAR OF EDGE / LET DOOR CLOSE FIRST. Written for hotels, resorts, hospitals and large restaurants.

Why this sign matters

Prevents pinches. It protects staff from a minor to moderate injury.

Where to post it

Mount at car door.

Who orders it

hotel engineers, banquet and room service managers, food service directors, maintenance leads.

Rust-resistant .065 aluminum, UV-resistant print, pre-drilled in all four corners. Made in the USA. Related standards and practice to review for your site: ANSI Z535.4 CAUTION; OSHA 1910.212 general machine guarding practice. A sign supports your site procedures; it does not replace training or supervision.
